blocks.text: SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–San Miguel Beer rode the inspiration provided by veteran Chris Ross to defeat Barangay Ginebra, 108-102, on Friday, forcing their 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series to a deciding Game 5 at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Ross had 20 points, six rebounds, nine assists and five steals, as the Beermen overcame a 14-point halftime lead and 17 early in the third to secure a second straight win after being pushed to the brink of elimination with a 0-2 deficit.
